subject: Cloud QC-1b: OPERATOR DECISION — remediate historical {house}-index progress pollution
description:
Removing the errant Complete Module button (Cloud QC-1 for 4 house hubs, Cloud QC-1c for web/simulators shim) is PREVENTION-ONLY. Students who already clicked have a bogus module id in progress.houses[house].modulesCompleted[] — inflating progressPercent + XP, syncing to the Firestore instructor dashboard / tenant class progress, and possibly falsely unlocking the 'explorer' achievement (checkExplorerAchievement counts ANY completed record per house).

POLLUTED IDS (5 total): ai-index, cloud-index, script-index, web-index (the 4 hubs), AND web-simulators-index (the redirect shim fixed in QC-1c #192 — note: it also did copyLegacyKey('web','web-index','web-simulators-index') so a web-index click could have propagated). Any cleanup pass MUST include all 5. Refs: sym-15-deferred-renames.md:57, PROG_003_REPORT.json:741.

Decision for operator: (a) run a one-time cleanup pass to strip all 5 ids from modulesCompleted + decrement MODULES_COMPLETED_KEY + re-evaluate explorer, across localStorage + Firestore (prod write — gated); or (b) accept the stale pollution as low-impact and defer. Also: audit how many real students are affected first. Requires production Firestore write authorization. Part of #189.
